description: If \(\kappa\) is infinite, \(N\) is \(\kappa\)-saturated, and the specified partial elementary map \(f:A\to B\) has \(|A|<\kappa\), then every \(a\in M\) admits an elementary extension \(g:A\cup\{a\}\to B\cup\{b\}\) preserving all old values and satisfying \(g(a)=b\). If \(a\notin A\), then \(b\notin B\); both enlarged sets have size below \(\kappa\).
